::: {#def-cond-gaussian}
#### Conditional Gaussian model

A **conditional Gaussian model** for outcomes $Y_1, \ldots, Y_n$
with covariate values $x_1, \ldots, x_n$
(each a single value or a vector)
says that, given the covariates,
the outcomes are independent and Gaussian,
each centered on a mean function $\mean(x)$
evaluated at its own covariate values,
with its own variance $\sigma_i^2$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
Y_i \mid X_i = x_i &\simind \ndist{\mean_i, \sigma_i^2},\\
\mean_i &\eqdef \mean(x_i).
\end{aligned}
$$
:::
